Zicfiss provides a 16-bit version of the `SSPUSH x1` instruction using the Zcmop defined `C.MOP.1` encoding. The `C.SSPUSH x1` expands to `SSPUSH x1` . The `SSPUSH` instruction and its compressed form `C.SSPUSH` can be used to push a link register on the shadow stack. The `SSPUSH` and `C.SSPUSH` instructions perform a store identically to the existing store instructions, with the difference that the base is implicitly `ssp` and the width is implicitly `XLEN` .
